And the middle is shared. Model APIs, agents, evals, Python plus TypeScript. The growth engineer takes a business problem, a low conversion rate and ships the fix. The product engineer knows a convincing demo from a dependable product and when the main software beats AI, one leans towards distribution and the other lean towards the model and the person using it. So which one do you hire first? If users already touch your AI feature and it is wrong too often, the product engineer first.
